title: Fantasia
oneLine: An unattended agent on a dedicated Mac Mini. Each night it researches new AI releases, weighs about eight candidate ideas, then builds, tests and publishes one project with a live demo.

specs.Stack: Claude Code, Python, Bash, launchd, GitHub CLI, Tailscale

intake.question: What number can you put on it?
intake.answer: 50 public repositories shipped since September 2026, one per night on 45 of the last 47 nights. Each one publishes the agent's reasoning.

intake.question: What did you decide, and what did you reject?
intake.answer: The agent runs without approval prompts, so I designed the safety model around that: an isolated non-admin account, a separate GitHub identity, a command guard that blocks destructive shell and git operations, and an SSH-only network policy.
